acceptance: A clean direct load of `https://benchbox.dev/results/query` resolves to a usable Find runs page rather than a 404/bootstrap failure.
A direct filter/share URL for the query page restores its selected filters and shows matching published rows.
In-app navigation to the same route still works, and the Results Explorer reports no DuckDB worker initialization or result-loading errors.
Verify the fixed route in the deployed site after an authorized deployment; until then, verify the candidate build and record the live deployment limitation.
context: Production Chromium smoke on 2026-10-11: direct navigation to `/results/query` received 404, redirected through the configured `/results/` fallback, then showed `DuckDB instantiate did not respond within 30000ms` with no database request. A separate in-app click from `/results/` loaded the Find runs view and 414 rows. The same failure occurred in two clean direct-load attempts after closing other Results tabs.
description: The live Results Explorer loads `/results/query` when reached by in-app navigation, but a direct production load returned HTTP 404, ran the `/results/` SPA fallback, and then displayed `DuckDB instantiate did not respond within 30000ms`; no results database request followed. This reproduced on two clean Chromium tab loads, while in-app navigation on the already-loaded overview showed 414 runs. Root cause remains unisolated; treat as a confirmed user-facing failure of the direct query route and investigate the static fallback / DuckDB initialization path before choosing a fix.
